user.title: Connect to a SolaX Pocket WiFi dongle
user.description: The dongle must be reachable directly from Home Assistant. The local password is normally the registration number printed on its label.

data_description.host: For example, 192.168.1.100. Do not include a path.
data_description.password: Often starts with S and is printed as the dongle registration number.

error.cannot_connect: Could not read valid data from the dongle. Check its address and network access.
error.invalid_auth: The dongle rejected the local password.
error.unsupported_device: This inverter response layout has not been verified for safe local control.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Check the logs.
